## The hits counter was lying to you

Small release, real fixes. The big one: if an AirTag (or anything else broadcasting BLE) was sitting near the device, its "hits" count on the LOG screen would just keep climbing forever — because it was counting every single raw advertisement packet instead of actual distinct sightings. AirTags advertise every 1-2 seconds, so leaving one on the table next to the device for an hour could rack up thousands of "hits" for something that never left. It now only counts a new hit when a device actually goes quiet and comes back, which is what "hits" was supposed to mean the whole time.

Also caught myself lying to Squachy: his per-background idle comments ("Aquarium mode. Very zen." etc.) were still indexed against a background list from two releases ago, before I removed three of them. Which meant every background after "Aquarium" had quietly been saying some OTHER background's line this whole time. Fixed, and now bolted down with a compile-time check so it can't happen again without the build just refusing to compile.

### The actually-useful part
- **Fixed**: detection log's "hits" counter no longer increments on every raw BLE packet — only on genuine new sightings (a device going stale and reappearing)
- **Fixed**: Squachy's background-specific idle comments were misaligned since the Radar/Rain/Aurora removal — every background past Aquarium was showing the wrong line
- Reverted the LOG screen's per-row type label back to the plain default font — the fancier font from last release didn't actually look good there
- Removed the Cryptid Cam ("night vision") background
- Unicorn outfit's horn now grows out of the actual top of his head instead of floating above his hair like it forgot where it was supposed to be
- First-boot walkthrough now actually mentions the Settings and rotate buttons in the title bar, which — six releases in — I somehow never told anyone about
